chat.title: Chat
chat.readOnly: Only the owner and collaborators can chat.

tour.helpBody: This tour and the keyboard shortcuts live in the help menu, up here on every screen.
tour.boardBody: Drag pieces to move; everyone in the room sees the same position live. Draw arrows and highlights, drop comments — the board is a shared canvas, not just a diagram.
tour.analysisPanelBody: Turn Stockfish on for the eval bar and best-move arrows, choose how many lines to see, and click any move to jump there. Variations branch freely.
tour.vizBoxBody: Two list views of the game: Moments (the biggest swings as mini boards) and Report (accuracy per side and every marked move with the engine's best alternative). Both appear after you run Analyze game.
tour.timelineBandBody: Whole-game charts stacked on one shared move axis: the Eval curve (mistakes dotted, captures marked), Material (who's up what), Activity (who has the more active pieces) and Clocks (how long each move took — needs a clocked import). Toggle layers on or off; click or drag any chart to jump to that position.
tour.roomPanelBody: The code to share, copy and leave — plus where you and the room are hosted and your current lag.
tour.gameListBody: Import PGNs or Lichess links, start a fresh board, switch between games — a room holds several at once.
tour.memberListBody: See who's here, follow the presenter's board, or hand the mic to someone else. Roles — owner, collaborator, viewer — gate who can edit.

evidence.analyzeHint: What has been played from this position, and how did games reach it?
evidence.empty: Nothing here yet — run the analysis for this position.
evidence.noCandidates: No historical examples found for this position yet.
evidence.error: The analysis failed — please try again.
evidence.menuNone: No continuations recorded for this position yet.
evidence.positionChanged: The position changed — run the analysis again to see examples for it.
evidence.helpPositionBody: What matched between your position and this game: pawn structure, material, piece placement (e.g. 13/14 pieces match), side to move and castling.
evidence.helpRouteBody: How this game reached its position compared to yours: how many plies were shared and the first move that differed (e.g. White played e4 where this game played e3).
evidence.helpFamiliesBody: What each side played next — and, when the match is strong, whether it followed the most common continuation. The raw similarity numbers live under Comparison details.
evidence.helpHistoricalBody: Games counts how many different games this position appeared in; occurrences count repeats within the same game. Same game only marks a position repeated within one game — not an independent example.
evidence.helpFlagsBody: Short labels for the differences found — e.g. tempo twin: identical placement, the other side to move.
evidence.readOnly: This room is read-only — historical analysis is available in rooms you can edit.
